blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets.
To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology.
Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers.
Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs).
Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance.
Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively.
Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.
The PhotoMOCI dataset is publicly available on Kaggle at Parola (2025) .
blocks.zh:
通过照相成像及早检测口腔癌,是大规模口腔检查的一个有希望的途径。 然而,由于缺少高质量、附加说明的数据集,发展强有力的深层学习模式往往受到阻碍。
为解决这一局限性,采用了摄影多用途口腔癌成像(PhotoMOCI)数据集这一新颖和精密的资源,用于在口腔肿瘤学的多个诊断任务中开发模型。
随后进行了一项综合基准研究,以调查各种数据增强战略如何影响图像分类器的性能.
我们的分析跨越不同的基因AI框架,评价传统方法相对于先进基因方法的功效,包括基因异常网络(GANs)和扩散模型(DMs).
此外,我们提议采用合成图像过滤器(SIF),这是一种基于两个辅助模型选择具体样本的机制: 合成代用分类器以确保样品能代表目标类和合成图像探测器,以验证它们看起来是现实的,从而只选择有助于改善下游性能的高功率图像.
在所有经过评价的数据集和分类器中,最好的SIF过滤设置在所有情况下都比传统的增强提高准确性,PhotoMOCI的增益分别为+1.73%和+2.35%,ResNet50和VIT的KOCD的增益分别为+2.38%和+2.08%。
我们的研究结果表明,虽然直接应用基因数据增强可能会产生性能下降,但是,考虑到(一) 合成数据的外观如何真实,(二) 如何反映归属类的歧视性特征,SIF的整合提供了一个简单而有效的机制,可以过滤出在培训期间混淆分类者的合成样品。
PhotoMOCI数据集在帕罗拉的Kaggle(2025)上公开提供.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Oral cancer (OC) remains a common and aggressive malignancy of the oral cavity, posing a substantial global burden of morbidity and mortality Kim and Kim (2020) . This underscores the need for improved early recognition strategies Kim and Kim (2020) ; Di Fede et al. (2024) , since, despite advances in treatment such as surgical resection and chemotherapy, the five-year survival rate remains around 60% Zhou et al. (2022) . Consequently, photographic screening may support the early recognition and referral of suspicious oral lesions, while definitive diagnosis remains based on clinical assessment and, when indicated, histopathological examination Bramati et al. (2021) ; Ribeiro et al. (2022) .
An effective screening must balance accessibility, speed, and cost-efficiency Ribeiro et al. (2022) . In this regard, recent research has explored the integration of Deep Learning (DL) with photographic imaging as a decision-support tool for oral lesion recognition and screening, rather than as a replacement for clinical or histopathological diagnosis Cimino et al. (2025) ; Parola et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
口腔癌(OC)仍是口腔常见且具有攻击性的恶性肿瘤,给全球带来了巨大的发病率和死亡率负担金和金(2020年). 这突出说明有必要改进金和金的早期识别战略(2020年); Di Fede等人(2024年),因为尽管在手术切除和化疗等治疗上有所进步,五年存活率仍然保持在周等人(2022年)的60%左右. 因此,照片检查可能有助于及早发现和转诊可疑的口腔损伤,而最终诊断仍以临床评估为依据,如有说明,则以组织病理学检查Bramati等人(2021年);Ribeiro等人(2022年)。
有效的筛查必须兼顾无障碍、速度和成本效益(2022年)。 在这方面,最近的研究探索将深层学习(DL)与摄影成像结合起来,作为口腔损伤识别和筛查的决策支持工具,而不是替代临床或组织病理学诊断Cimino等人(2025年);Parola等人(2024年)。

blocks.en:
Since DL has shown considerable results in many medical image analyses, coupled with photographic imaging, it offers the potential to support clinical decision-making by providing diagnostic insights while reducing the cost related to other more expensive medical imaging techniques, such as X-ray, CT-scan, etc. Rajpurkar et al. (2022) ; Lee et al. (2021) . The resulting performance therefore should not be interpreted as evidence of autonomous oral cancer diagnosis or as a substitute for the corresponding clinical and histopathological reference assessment.
However, the development of robust DL-based systems is significantly constrained by the lack of large-scale, high-quality, and well-annotated datasets that are essential for training DL architectures Alzubaidi et al. (2023) ; Whang et al. (2022) .
Indeed, as highlighted in Section 3 , oral cancer datasets for medical imaging are often limited in size due to challenges such as patient privacy concerns, the high cost and complexity of expert annotation, and the relatively low prevalence of early-stage lesions in clinical populations Alzubaidi et al. (2023) ; Whang et al. (2022) ; Di Fede et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
由于DL在许多医疗影像分析中显示出相当的成果,再加上摄影成像,它通过提供诊断洞察力,同时降低X射线,CT扫描等更昂贵的医疗影像技术的相关成本,从而提供了支持临床决策的潜力. Rajpurkar等人(2022年); Lee等人(2021年). 因此,所产生的表现不应被解释为自主口服癌症诊断的证据,或替代相应的临床和病理学参考评估。
然而,由于缺乏对培训DL架构Alzubaidi等人(2023年)至关重要的大规模、高质量和有说明的数据集,开发基于DL的强大系统受到严重限制; 旺等 (2022) (中文(简体) ).
实际上,正如第3节所强调的那样,由于病人隐私问题、专家注释费用高、复杂性高以及临床人群早期损伤流行率较低等挑战(Alzubaidi等人,2023年),用于医疗成像的口腔癌症数据集往往规模有限; Whang等人(2022年); Di Fede等人(2024年).

blocks.en:
In this context, synthetic data generation emerges as a viable solution. By producing realistic images that increase visual variability within the photographic lesion domain, synthetic data can potentially augment existing datasets and improve the performance of DL models trained on them Tang and others (2023) ; Alzubaidi et al. (2023) .
The effectiveness of synthetic image generation as a data augmentation technique varies across different medical domains. While it has shown clear benefits in small-data scenarios, where real data are scarce, and model generalization is limited, it is not always consistently effective in broader or more data-rich applications Mantegna et al. (2025) . In contrast, traditional transformation-based augmentation techniques often prove more effective and robust in large-data settings Mantegna et al. (2025) , offering simpler and more computationally efficient improvements without the complexities of generative modeling.
blocks.zh:
在这方面,合成数据的生成成为一种可行的解决办法。 通过制作现实的图像,增加照片损伤域内的视觉可变性,合成数据可以潜在地增强现有的数据集,并改进对Tang等人(2023年)进行培训的DL模型的性能;Alzubaidi等人(2023年)。
合成图像生成作为一种数据增强技术的有效性因不同的医学领域而异. 虽然它显示出在小数据假设中明显的好处,因为实际数据很少,模型的概括性有限,但在更广泛或更多数据丰富的应用程序Mantegna等人(2025年)中并不总是一贯有效. 相比之下,传统的基于变换的增强技术在大数据环境Mantegna等人(2025年)中往往被证明更有效和更有力,在没有基因模型复杂的情况下提供更简单、更高效的计算改进。

blocks.en: As discussed in the literature review (Section 2.1 ), synthetic data augmentation has been widely adopted in medical imaging and oral cancer. However, to the best of our knowledge, a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of synthetic data for photographic oral cancer imaging remains lacking. Existing studies typically focus on a single generative model, most often GAN-based approaches, or rely on a single dataset, which is frequently not publicly available, as highlighted in the dataset review in Section 3 . Moreover, many contributions address alternative imaging modalities, such as histopathological images, limiting their applicability to photographic screening.
blocks.zh: 如文献评论(第2.1节)所述,在医学成像和口腔癌中广泛采用了合成数据增强法。 然而,据我们所知,仍然缺乏对口腔癌症摄影成像合成数据的系统和全面的评价。 现有研究通常侧重于单一的基因模型,最常见的是基于GAN的方法,或者依赖一个通常不公开的数据集,正如第3节数据集审查所强调的那样. 此外,许多贡献涉及替代成像方式,如组织病理学图像,限制了其适用于摄影放映。

blocks.en:
To address both the limited availability of datasets and the absence of a comprehensive benchmark, we introduce a novel dataset designed to support future benchmarks and enable a more systematic evaluation of synthetic data generation for photographic oral cancer imaging.
Specifically, the contributions of this work are:
blocks.zh:
为了解决数据集有限和缺乏全面基准的问题,我们采用了一个新的数据集,旨在支持今后的基准,并能够更系统地评价口腔癌摄影成像合成数据的生成。
具体而言,这项工作的贡献是:

blocks.en: • Introducing a novel dataset in this scenario of data scarcity, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, a well-curated collection for oral cancer that enables the development of models for multiple tasks. • Investigating the impact of different data augmentation strategies on image classification performance, and presenting a comprehensive benchmark across multiple datasets, image classifiers, generative models, and augmentation techniques. • Proposing the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF) , a simple but effective strategy relying on two auxiliary classification problems to select specific synthetic images that contribute to improving the final classifier performance, based on how a synthetic image looks real and how it matches discriminative features of the belonging class.
blocks.zh: • 支助 在这种数据稀缺的情景中引入了一个新的数据集,即摄影多用途口腔癌成像(PhotoMOCI)数据集,这是口腔癌的精密收集,能够开发多种任务的模型. • 调查不同数据增强战略对图像分类性能的影响,提出涵盖多个数据集、图像分类器、基因模型和增强技术的全面基准。 · 提出合成图像过滤器(SIF),这是一种简单而有效的策略,依靠两个辅助分类问题来选择有助于改进最终分类器性能的特定合成图像,基于合成图像的外观如何真实,如何匹配归属类的区别特征.

blocks.en: Introducing a novel dataset in this scenario of data scarcity, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, a well-curated collection for oral cancer that enables the development of models for multiple tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这种数据稀缺的情景中引入了一个新的数据集,即摄影多用途口腔癌成像(PhotoMOCI)数据集,这是口腔癌的精密收集,能够开发多种任务的模型.

blocks.en: Investigating the impact of different data augmentation strategies on image classification performance, and presenting a comprehensive benchmark across multiple datasets, image classifiers, generative models, and augmentation techniques.
blocks.zh: 调查不同数据增强战略对图像分类性能的影响,提出涵盖多个数据集、图像分类器、基因模型和增强技术的全面基准。

blocks.en: Proposing the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF) , a simple but effective strategy relying on two auxiliary classification problems to select specific synthetic images that contribute to improving the final classifier performance, based on how a synthetic image looks real and how it matches discriminative features of the belonging class.
blocks.zh: 提出合成图像过滤器(SIF),是一种简单而有效的策略,依靠两个辅助分类问题来选择有助于改进最终分类器性能的特定合成图像,基于合成图像的外观如何真实,如何匹配归属类的区别特征.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: DL has achieved strong performance in medical imaging, but adoption is often limited by small datasets caused by privacy constraints, high annotation costs, and the rarity of certain diseases, leading to class imbalance and poor case representation Goodfellow and others (2014) ; Zhang and Qie (2023) ; Johnson and Khoshgoftaar (2019) . Thus, in Section 2.1 , we review traditional and synthetic data augmentation techniques that expand dataset size and diversity, including Generative Adversarial Networks and Diffusion Models, with a specific focus on conditioning mechanisms in Section 2.2 .
blocks.zh: DL在医学成像上取得了强劲的性能,但由于隐私限制,注释成本高,以及某些疾病的罕见,导致阶级失衡和病例代表性差的Goodfellow等人(2014年),张和琦(2023年),约翰逊和霍什戈夫塔阿尔(2019年)等原因导致的小型数据集往往限制了收养. 因此,在第2.1节中,我们审查了扩大数据集规模和多样性的传统和合成数据扩增技术,包括基因横向网络和扩散模型,并特别侧重于第2.2节中的调节机制。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data augmentation technique review
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据增强技术审查

blocks.en:
Traditional data augmentation . Traditional data augmentation increases training variability through predefined image transformations Krizhevsky et al. (2012) , commonly categorized as geometric or photometric Tang and others (2023) ; Shorten and Khoshgoftaar (2019) . Geometric transformations modify spatial structure (e.g., rotation, flipping, scaling), whereas photometric transformations alter pixel intensities (e.g., brightness, contrast) or add noise.
These techniques, widely used in computer vision, have also proven effective in medical imaging applications Shin et al. (2016) ; Ronneberger et al. (2015) ; Wael Alosaimi (2022) ; Oya et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
传统数据增强 传统数据增强通过预先定义的图像转换(Krizhevsky等人(2012年)),通常归类为几何或光度唐等人(2023年);Shorten和Khoshgoftaar(2019年),增加了培训的可变性。 几何变换会修改空间结构(如旋转,翻转,缩放),而光度变换会改变像素强度(如亮度,对比度)或增加噪音.
这些技术在计算机视觉中广泛应用,在医学成像应用中也证明是有效的 Shin等人(2016年);Ronneberger等人(2015年);Wael Alosaimi(2022年);Oya等人(2023年)。

blocks.en:
Due to their computational efficiency Whang et al. (2022) , traditional augmentations are broadly adopted and generally improve performance compared to training without augmentation Tang and others (2023) ; Krizhevsky et al. (2012) ; Ronneberger et al. (2015) .
However, they cannot generate truly novel samples or pathological features, as they only modify existing images Shorten and Khoshgoftaar (2019) . This limits their effectiveness in scenarios with severe data scarcity, low diversity Alzubaidi et al. (2023) , or class imbalance Johnson and Khoshgoftaar (2019) ; Kazemzadeh and others (2024) , and they lack conditional generation capabilities.
In contrast, DL-based generative approaches show greater promise in small-data medical imaging settings Mantegna et al. (2025) , while traditional augmentation remains reliable for improving generalization in larger datasets Mantegna et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
由于计算效率 华为等. (2022年),传统扩增法被广泛采用,与培训相比一般提高性能,而不扩增唐等人(2023年);Krizhevsky等人(2012年);Ronneberger等人(2015年).
然而,它们不能产生真正新颖的样品或病理特征,因为它们只修改现有的图像Sorten和Khoshgoftaar(2019年). 这限制了它们在数据严重缺乏、多样性低的Alzubaidi等人(2023年)或班级失衡的Johnson和Khoshgoftaar(2019年),Kazemzadeh等人(2024年)的情景中的有效性,他们缺乏有条件的生成能力。
与此相反,基于DL的基因方法在小数据医学成像环境Mantegna等人(2025年)中显示出更大的希望,而传统的增强对于在更大的数据集Mantegna等人(2025年)中改进概括性仍然是可靠的。

blocks.en:
Generative Adversarial Networks .
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) Goodfellow and others (2014) represent the next generation of generative models after autoencoders (AEs) Hinton and Salakhutdinov (2006) and later Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) Kingma and Welling (2013) . They introduced an adversarial training paradigm involving a generator and a discriminator. Through this process, the generator progressively learns to synthesize visually realistic images that deceive the discriminator Goodfellow and others (2014) .
Despite their success, GANs can suffer from training instability and mode collapse, where only a limited subset of the data distribution is generated Arjovsky et al. (2017) ; Tang and others (2023) . Several variants addressed these issues, including Deep Convolutional GANs Radford et al. (2015) , Wasserstein GANs Arjovsky et al. (2017) , and StyleGAN Karras et al. (2019) , which enables high-quality image synthesis and controllable attribute manipulation Karras and others (2020) .
blocks.zh:
流传的散文网.
基因辅助网络(GANs) Goodfellow等人(2014年)代表了继自动编码器Hinton和Salakhutdinov(2006年)以及后来的Variational自动编码器(VAEs)Kingma和 Welling(2013年)之后的下一代基因模型. 他们采用了一种对抗性培训模式,涉及一名发电机和一名歧视者。 通过这一过程,生成者逐渐学会合成欺骗歧视者Goodfellow和其他人的视觉现实图像(2014年)。
尽管取得了成功,但GANs仍可能遭遇训练不稳定和模式崩溃,只有有限的数据分布子集生成Arjovsky等人(2017年);Tang等人(2023年). 几个变体处理这些问题,包括深革命GANs Radford等人(2015年),Wasserstein GANs Arjovsky等人(2017年),以及StyleGAN Karras等人(2019年),它们使得高品质的图像合成和控制属性操纵Karras等人(2020年)得以实现.

blocks.en:
GANs have been extensively applied in medical imaging for several generative tasks, including augmenting pathology contrast in mammography Rofena et al. (2025a) ; Rofena et al. (2025b) , synthetic augmentation to improve: liver classification in CT Frid-Adar et al. (2018) , covid-19 in chest X-rays Waheed et al. (2020) ; Neff et al. (2017) , dermatology Qasim et al. (2021) , and brain MRI classification Qi et al. (2020) .
In oral oncology, GANs have been used for oral cancer histology classification and segmentation Wael Alosaimi (2022) ; Dos Santos et al. (2023) and for fluorescence-based diagnosis Fujimoto et al. (2022) .
Conditional GANs further extend this framework by enabling class-specific data generation, particularly useful for rare conditions Mirza and Osindero (2014) ; Tang and others (2023) .
blocks.zh:
GAN在医学成像中被广泛应用于一些遗传性任务,包括乳房X射线学Rofena等人(2025a)中的增强病理对比;Rofena等人(2025b),合成增强以改善:CT Frid-Adar等人(2018)中的肝脏分类;胸腔X射线学Waheed等人(2020)中的covid-19;Neff等人(2017),皮肤学Qasim等人(2021),以及大脑核磁共振分类Qi等人(2020).
在口腔肿瘤学中,GANs被用于口腔癌组织学分类和分化Wael Alosaimi(2022年),Dos Santos等人(2023年)和基于荧光的诊断Fujimoto等人(2022年).
有条件 GANs进一步扩展了这一框架,使特定类别的数据生成成为可能,特别是对稀有条件的Mirza和Osindero(2014年);Tang等人(2023年)。

blocks.en:
Diffusion Models .
Diffusion Models (DMs) are the most recent class of generative models and have shown superior performance over previous approaches, especially in terms of image diversity Ho et al. (2020) ; Dhariwal and Nichol (2021) ; Tang and others (2023) .
DMs iteratively add Gaussian noise to training data and learn to reverse this process through denoising steps using UNet-based architectures Sohl-Dickstein et al. (2015) ; Ronneberger et al. (2015) ; Ho et al. (2020) . During generation, samples are obtained by iteratively denoising random noise. A major drawback is the need for many denoising steps, resulting in longer inference times than single-pass methods Ho et al. (2020) ; Tang and others (2023) .
To reduce computational costs, Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) perform diffusion in a compressed latent space learned via autoencoders Rombach et al. (2022) .
Additionally, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has been proposed as an efficient fine-tuning strategy, allowing diffusion models to adapt to new domains using minimal trainable parameters and reduced memory requirements Hu et al. (2021) ; Yang et al. (2024) .
Diffusion-based methods have been applied to address class imbalance in chest X-ray datasets Kazemzadeh and others (2024) ; Pinaya and others (2024) and dermatology images Sagers et al. (2023) . In oral cancer, diffusion models have been explored for histopathological images Uliana and Krohling (2025) , while their application to photographic images remains unexplored.
blocks.zh:
传播模式.
扩散模型(DMs)是最新一类的基因模型,表现出优于以往方法的表现,特别是在图像多样性Ho等人(2020年),Dhariwal和Nichol(2021年),Tang等人(2023年)方面.
DMs迭代地将高斯噪音添加到培训数据中,并学会通过使用基于UNet的架构Sohl-Dickstein等人(2015年);Ronneberger等人(2015年);Ho等人(2020年)的去名步骤来逆转这一过程. 在生成过程中,通过迭代地去声随机噪声来获取样本. 一个主要的缺点是需要许多去诺步骤,导致比单传方法Ho等人(2020年);唐等人(2023年)的推论时间更长.
为降低计算成本,Lententnt Difusion Models(LDMs)在通过自动编码器Rombach等人(2022年)学到的压缩潜在空间进行传播。
此外,Low-Rank适应(Lora)被提议作为有效的微调战略,使传播模型能够利用最低限度的可训练参数和减少的记忆要求Hu等人(2021年);Yang等人(2024年)。
采用了基于传播的方法来解决胸部X射线数据集Kazemzadeh等人(2024年)、Pinaya等人(2024年)和皮肤病图像Sagers等人(2023年)的分类失衡问题。 在口腔癌中,探索了组织病理学影像Uliana和Krohling(2025年)的传播模型,而其应用于摄影影像的应用仍未被探索.

blocks.en: 2.2 Condition mechanism in image synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像合成中的条件机制

blocks.en: Conditioning mechanisms guide generative models toward specific attributes and visual features Bourou et al. (2024) . In oral cancer diagnosis, conditioning can support class-specific data generation.
blocks.zh: 条件机制指导基因模型向特定属性和视觉特征Bourou等人(2024年)。 在口腔癌诊断中,调理可以支持特定阶级的数据生成.

blocks.en:
Conditioning in GANs . Conditioning extends GANs by incorporating auxiliary class label information c c (e.g., one-hot class encoding, string class name) into the generator G G and/or discriminator D D .
Given the GAN latent space z z , basic conditioning approaches consist of concatenating c c to z z , which is effective for low-dimensional inputs such as class labels Bourou et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2020) .
Alternatively, Auxiliary Classifier GANs (AC-GANs) introduce an extra classification head in the discriminator, enforcing class label semantics using an additional supervised loss term Odena et al. (2017) ; Bourou et al. (2024) .

blocks.en:
Conditioning in Diffusion Models .
Diffusion Models support a wide range of conditioning signals, including text, labels, images, and segmentation masks Zhan et al. (2024) . Conditioning can be integrated at different stages using operations such as concatenation, summation, or cross-attention. Text and class labels are typically embedded before being injected into the denoising process Zhan et al. (2024) .
Images or masks can directly guide the diffusion trajectory by constraining regions of interest or initializing the latent representation Ho et al. (2020) .
These mechanisms are particularly well suited to medical imaging, where precise control over generated content is critical Rombach et al. (2022) ; Kazemzadeh and others (2024) .

blocks.en: In this section, we review current public data resources and their limitations. Then, we introduce a novel dataset: Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们审查当前的公共数据资源及其局限性。 然后,我们介绍一个新的数据集: 摄影多功能口腔癌成像。

blocks.en:
We review publicly available oral cancer (OC) photographic datasets released between 2020 and 2025, excluding other imaging modalities, such as histopathology and radiography.
Despite the growing number of works on OC imaging, the availability of datasets remains a major limitation. Many studies rely on private or poorly documented datasets, primarily due to patient privacy concerns and institutional constraints, which significantly hinder reproducibility and fair methodological comparison.
Indeed, several datasets are accessible only upon request and require detailed justification from potential users Rabinovici-Cohen et al. (2024) ; Lee et al. (2023) ; Lin et al. (2021) ; Jubair et al. (2022) ; Welikala et al. (2021) ; Heo et al. (2022) ; Warin et al. (2022) , resulting in a time-consuming and often discouraging process. Even more restrictive are works in which datasets are not accessible at all, either because they were never intended for public release or due to legal and ethical restrictions Kouketsu et al. (2024) ; Vinayahalingam et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
我们审查2020年至2025年间公开发布的口服癌症(OC)摄影数据集,不包括其他成像模式,如组织病理学和放射学.
尽管关于OC成像的作品越来越多,但数据集的可用性仍然是一大限制. 许多研究依赖于私人或记录不全的数据集,这主要是由于病人对隐私的关切和体制限制,这严重阻碍了复制和公平的方法比较。
事实上,几个数据集只有在提出要求时才能查阅,并且要求潜在用户Rabinovici-Cohen等人(2024年)、Lee等人(2023年)、Lin等人(2021年)、Jubair等人(2022年)、Welikala等人(2021年)、Heo等人(2022年)、Warin等人(2022年)详细说明理由,导致过程耗时,而且往往令人沮丧。 更具有限制性的是,由于从未打算公开发布数据集,或由于对Kouketsu等人的法律和道德限制(2024年);Vinayahalingam等人(2024年)。

blocks.en:
Table 1 provides an overview of publicly available photographic datasets sorted by year, detailing size and the supported computer vision downstream tasks.
Such analysis highlights several limitations in the datasets used for oral healthcare research. First, all publicly available oral cancer datasets contain fewer than 1,000 samples, making it difficult to generalize findings. Second, the number of samples further decreases when annotations are provided for multiple downstream tasks, such as classification, detection, or segmentation. Indeed, three out of five datasets are curated only for binary classification (cancer vs. non-cancer). The only dataset supporting multiple downstream tasks comprises just 323 images.
Finally, note that many publicly available datasets appear larger than they are, as they include the ”healthy” class. These images are easier to collect because they do not require waiting for rare pathological events. Consequently, they are often used to artificially inflate dataset sizes, potentially overselling the actual clinical contribution while the volume of high-value pathological samples remains limited.
This scarcity of well-annotated, publicly accessible datasets underscores the need for greater efforts to create and share resources that support robust and reproducible research in healthcare.

最后,请注意,许多公开的数据集似乎比它们大,因为它们包括“健康”类。 这些图像更容易收集,因为它们不需要等待罕见的病理事件. 因此,它们往往被用来人为地增加数据集的尺寸,有可能过度推销实际临床贡献,而高价值病理学样本的数量仍然有限。

blocks.en:
With this premise, we introduce the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging dataset, a multipurpose dataset designed for cancer recognition in oral cavity photographic imaging. It supports a wide range of downstream tasks (some of which were previously addressed), including major computer vision problems such as image classification, object detection Parola et al. (2023) , and semantic segmentation Parola et al. (2025a) , as well as clinically oriented applications like case-based reasoning Parola et al. (2024) ; Kenny and Keane (2019) ; Cimino et al. (2025) ; Keane and Kenny (2019) .
By offering a dataset combining technical and clinical needs, PhotoMOCI supports research on photographic oral cancer screening. Nevertheless, this work specifically focuses on image classification.

PhotoMOCI通过提供一套综合技术和临床需要的数据集,支持口腔癌照片筛查研究。 尽管如此,这项工作特别侧重于图像分类.

blocks.en:
Between 2021 and 2025, photographic images of the oral cavity were collected from patients attending medical examinations at the Oral Medicine Unit of the P. Giaccone University Hospital in Palermo, Italy. Dental hygienists and oral medicine consultants acquired these images using a Nikon D7200 digital camera equipped with a 105 mm lens and an SB-R200 macro flash, offering an inexpensive alternative to advanced imaging systems. The resulting image dataset is composed of high-quality resolution ranging from ∼ \sim 2500x2000 to ∼ \sim 6000x4000 pixels.
Additionally, histopathological analysis was performed to confirm the diagnosis and subsequent labeling.
The final version includes 700 images belonging to three specific pathologies: aphthous , traumatic , and neoplastic (cancer class). The majority of images in the PhotoMOCI dataset feature a single lesion; however, 22 images contain multiple instances of lesions within the same photo for a total of 730 oral lesions (253 aphthous, 257 traumatic, and 220 neoplastic). Note that there are no instances where lesions from different classes coexist within the same image. All cases involving multiple lesions pertain to a specific scenario: the multiple aphthous lesions. The dataset contains no more than one image from the same patient.

Figure 1 summarizes the PhotoMOCI metadata distribution by sex and age group, with each bar split according to the three pathology classes. blocks.en:
For the core computer vision tasks, the images were annotated using the open-source tool COCO Annotator Brooks (2019) , generating a dataset in the standard COCO format for computer vision applications.
Initial annotation of lesion regions was performed manually by a dental intern, who delineated lesion boundaries and assigned pathology labels returned by histopathological analysis. Subsequently, all annotated images were reviewed and refined by two senior clinicians with more clinical experience. The revisions focused exclusively on segmentation boundaries to improve their accuracy, as the labels are based on the histopathological results.
The bounding box is then generated by considering the minimum rectangle that encloses the lesion segment. The images and the json annotation files can be accessed on Kaggle Parola (2025) .

具体来说,我们采用了两个最先进的基因模型。 第一个是稳定扩散Rombach等人(2022年),这是一个通过LORA域适应技术微调的潜在扩散框架。 第二种是StyleGAN3 Karras等人(2021年),它引入了一种无别名的生成器,用低通道滤波器取代常规的提升取样和过滤操作.
对于每个基因模型,我们探索两个条件策略,导致四个不同的合成代系:

blocks.en: • SD(txt) : Stable Diffusion conditioned on text. Lesion descriptions are first encoded into embeddings using CLIP Radford et al. (2021) . These embeddings are then combined with the latent representations during the denoising process by summing them, allowing the model to generate images that closely align with the provided textual descriptions. • SD(txt+img) : Stable Diffusion conditioned on both text and images. Similar to the previous setup, textual embeddings are fused with image embeddings. However, instead of executing the full denoising trajectory from pure noise, the process is initialized from a conditioning image and proceeds for a limited number of denoising steps. This approach leverages the input image as a structural prior. Figure 3 illustrates this text–image conditioning scheme for a neoplastic lesion, where the conditioning image is injected at different stages of the denoising process. • SG3(lbl) : StyleGAN3 conditioned on class labels. Here, labels are one-hot encoded and projected into a learned embedding space. The resulting embeddings are then concatenated with the generator’s latent codes, enabling label-aware synthesis. • AC-SG3 : Auxiliary Classifier StyleGAN3 conditioned on class labels. In this configuration, conditioning is enforced through the discriminator, which is augmented with an auxiliary classifier head that predicts the class label in addition to the adversarial objective, thereby encouraging the generator to generate real images that are not only indistinguishable from real images but also belong to the specified class.

blocks.en:
While generative models can synthesize large volumes of data, the utility of such samples is not always significant. Poorly generated samples, characterized by artifacts or semantic misalignment with the target class, introduce label noise that can degrade the performance of downstream classifiers. To mitigate this, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF) , a mechanism designed to select only those samples ( x j , y j ) (x_{j},y_{j}) from 𝒟 s ​ y ​ n ​ t ​ h \mathcal{D}_{synth} that enhance the generalization of the final oral cancer classifier.
As illustrated in Figure 2 ( green dotted box), SIF implements a filtering mechanism based on two auxiliary models trained for complementary purposes: a Synthetic Proxy Classifier (SPC), denoted as f S ​ P ​ C f_{SPC} , and a Synthetic Image Detector (SID), denoted as f S ​ I ​ D f_{SID} .

Intuitively, this model evaluates whether a synthetic image x j x_{j} exhibits visual patterns coherent with its intended label y j y_{j} .
On the other hand, SID ( f S ​ I ​ D f_{SID} ) is a binary classifier trained to discriminate real images x i ∈ 𝒟 r ​ e ​ a ​ l x_{i}\in\mathcal{D}_{real} from synthetic images x j ∈ 𝒟 s ​ y ​ n ​ t ​ h x_{j}\in\mathcal{D}_{synth} .

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en:
The experiment section is organized into two parts:
The first part, presented in Section 5.1 , describes how we finetune different generative architectures and reports experiments on synthetic image generation. Then, we describe how we develop the auxiliary classifiers composing SIF and how it is used to train oral lesion classifiers under different synthetic data augmentation setups in Sections 5.2 and 5.3 , respectively. Finally, we conduct an ablation study to understand the impact of the different SIF components on the overall filter.
The experiments are implemented in PyTorch 1.10.2 (CUDA 11.3) and are publicly available on GitHub at Parola et al. (2025b) . They are run on NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 32GB of memory.
blocks.zh:
实验部分分为两部分:

Datasets . We evaluate our approach on PhotoMOCI for the multi-class problem, and on KOCD (version 1, released under Apache 2.0) Rashid (2024) for the binary problem, since they represent the largest and most recent datasets available in this field.
For experimental consistency and reproducibility, all experiments on PhotoMOCI follow the official dataset partition, consisting of 490, 105, and 105 images for the training, validation, and test sets, available at Parola (2025) .
The KOCD dataset consists of 950 images labeled according to a binary classification setup: 450 cancer and 500 non-cancer. The images are collected from 950 patients, with each patient contributing one image; therefore, no near-duplicate images are present in the dataset.
Since KOCD is released without predefined partitions, we define a hold-out 70%-15%-15% split, resulting in 665 (321 cancer and 344 non-cancer), 142 (64 cancer and 78 non-cancer), and 143 (66 cancer and 77 non-cancer) images for the training, validation, and test sets, respectively. The split is generated with a fixed random seed and is therefore reproducible across all experiments Parola et al. (2025b) . For both PhotoMOCI and KOCD, the same splits are consistently used throughout all the experiments.

blocks.en: 5.1 Synthetic Image Generation
blocks.zh: 5.1 合成图像生成

blocks.en:
Configuration Setup .
We evaluated four distinct synthetic image generation setups on 100 samples per class for each epoch against the real data.
Alongside such generation setups, we established a traditional augmentation baseline consisting of both geometric and photometric transformations: random flipping, color jittering, and affine transformations (rotations ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} , translations ± 15 % \pm 15\% , scaling 85-115%, and shearing ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} ). The quality of all synthetic sets was benchmarked against the original, non-augmented data. Generative models were finetuned on the training set and conditioned with dataset-specific prompts: ” a medical photograph of an ’x’ lesion ” for PhotoMOCI, where ’x’ is the class label (aphthous, traumatic, neoplastic), and ” a medical photograph of a ’x’ tissue ” for KOCD, where ’x’ was either cancerous or healthy (cancer and non-cancer classes). Image-conditional setups in the case of SD(txt+img), used images from the training set. Since image conditioning can occur at different stages of the diffusion process, as shown in Figure 3 , we empirically identified a range of steps that balance fidelity to the conditioning image with sufficient diversity in the generated output. Specifically, it is applied at a random step between steps 55 and 75 of the 100-step diffusion process.

配置设置 。

除了这些生成设置之外,我们建立了传统的增强基线,包括几何和光度的转换:随机翻转、彩色分裂、以及芳香的转换(旋转±10 \pm 10\circ}、翻译±15%\pm 15\,缩放85-115%,剪切±5\pm 5\circ})。 所有合成组的质量均以原始的非强化数据为基准。 基因模型在培训单元上进行了微调,并附有特定数据集提示: " 用于PhotoMOCI的X型损伤医学照片 " ,其中X型为类标签(痛苦、创伤、肿瘤), " 用于KOCD的X型组织医学照片 " ,其中x型为癌症或健康(癌症和非癌症类)。 SD(txt+img)情况下的图像条件设置,使用训练集的图像. 由于图像调节可以在扩散过程的不同阶段发生,如图3所示,我们实证地确定了一系列步骤,这些步骤在调节图像的忠诚度与生成的输出的充分多样性之间保持平衡. 具体来说,它是在100步传播过程的第55步至第75步之间随机应用的.

blocks.en:
For the training of our conditional and AC-StyleGAN3 variants, we adopted the ‘stylegan3-t‘ configuration and trained the models from scratch. With a batch size of 16 images, the training process stabilized with R1 regularization and a γ \gamma coefficient of 0.6. Distinct learning rates were set for the generator ( 2.5 × 10 − 3 2.5\times 10^{-3} ) and the discriminator ( 2.0 × 10 − 3 2.0\times 10^{-3} ). To prevent discriminator overfitting, we employed Adaptive Discriminator Augmentation (ADA) alongside real-time horizontal mirroring.
For the training of our latent diffusion models, we fine-tuned the Stable Diffusion v1.5 model using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The model was trained for a maximum of 200 epochs with a batch size of 32. We monitored the validation loss, ‘val/loss‘, to save the top three checkpoints. An 8-bit Adam optimizer was employed with a learning rate of 1.0 × 10 − 4 1.0\times 10^{-4} for the U-Net and 0.5 × 10 − 4 0.5\times 10^{-4} for the text encoder, using a weight decay of 1.0 × 10 − 2 1.0\times 10^{-2} . The LoRA configuration featured a rank of 16, an alpha of 32, and a dropout of 0.15, with adapters applied to the attention and projection modules of the U-Net and text encoder, respectively. blocks.en: Metrics . To evaluate the performance of generative models, we employ different established state-of-the-art metrics Jalali et al. (2023) . Such evaluation metrics can be categorized into two main groups. The first comprises distance-based metrics, including the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) Heusel et al. (2017) and Kernel Inception Distance (KID) Bińkowski et al. (2018) scores, which quantify the similarity between the distributions of generated and real data. The second group includes quality-based metrics that assess the fidelity and variability of the class labels predicted by a pre-trained classifier. This includes Precision and Recall Kynkäänniemi et al. (2019) , and Coverage Naeem et al. (2020) scores.

blocks.en: Results . Tables 2 and 3 report the synthetic image generation task results on PhotoMOCI and KOCD, respectively. Across both datasets, consistent trends emerge: SD(txt-img) generally outperforms the other approaches in most metrics, except Recall on PhotoMOCI and both Precision and Recall on KOCD. On PhotoMOCI, SD(txt) achieves higher Recall, indicating that, in the context of diffusion models, text-only conditioning leads to greater diversity in the generated samples, effectively acting as a “general-purpose” generator. However, this diversity negatively affects the quality, as indicated by its low precision value, meaning that many of the generated images are not realistic. On KOCD, SD(txt) again surpasses SD(txt-img) in Recall, while SG3(lbl) achieves the best Precision, with its capacity to generate images that, from the perspective of a pre-trained classifier, closely reflect the label distributions observed in real samples.

blocks.en: This insight is also supported by Figures 4 and 5 , which present examples of generated synthetic images by class with the considered generation strategies on PhotoMOCI and KOCD, respectively. Qualitatively, the images produced by SD(txt) are clearly recognizable as synthetic to the human eye, showing anatomical features of the oral cavity that do not exist in either dataset and exhibiting almost no variability within the same class. By contrast, SD(txt-img) and SG3(lbl) generate synthetic images that appear visually plausible and capture the distinctive features of the classes (e.g., necrotic tissue in the case of neoplastic lesions) in both datasets. Finally, a discrepancy can be observed in the quality of the images produced by AC-SG3 across datasets: on PhotoMOCI, the generated samples lack intra-class variability, displaying a recurring visual pattern within the same class, whereas this phenomenon is not present on KOCD. This suggests that AC-SG3 may struggle to generalize across settings, such as PhotoMOCI, where the class granularity is higher.

blocks.en:
Several relevant trends emerge from this analysis. Traditional data augmentation consistently outperforms training without augmentation by 1–2%, confirming its effectiveness in enhancing model generalizability.
Regarding the different synthetic data augmentation techniques, highlighted in gray, we observe setups where SIF improves performance over non-SIF counterparts and surpasses traditional augmentation. The adoption of synthetic data augmentation without SIF does not necessarily yield improvements. Indeed, on both PhotoMOCI and KOCD, integrating synthetic data produced via SD(txt) and AC-SG3 without SIF (represented in the first row of each two-row block) results in either a performance degradation or marginal gains that fail to surpass traditional augmentation, regardless of the classifier used.
However, by filtering images using SIF, a performance recovery is achieved when using AC-SG3 in three out of four cases (with ViT and ResNet on KOCD). This suggests that AC-SG3-based synthetic augmentation can generate high-quality images that, when selected by SIF, successfully drive performance gains. In contrast, this improvement is absent in the SD(txt) setup, where accuracy after applying SIF merely matches the results of training without augmentation. This is further validated by the composition of the filtered dataset, which consists of only a few dozen images compared to the hundreds of synthetic images generated. This indicates that SIF filters out the majority of synthetic images, effectively reverting to a dataset size comparable to the original real samples.
Finally, regarding SD(txt+img) and SG3(lbl), we observe an improvement even when SIF is not applied (around 1–2%) over the baseline, suggesting that both generative techniques produce high-quality images that improve generalization. Furthermore, these improvements become even more pronounced when SIF is adopted. Specifically, we observe an additional improvement of 0.520% and 0.608% when using SD(txt+img) and SG3(lbl), respectively.

blocks.en: From the figures, we observe that the SD(txt+img) and SG3(lbl) configurations exhibit consistent behavior across both PhotoMOCI and KOCD. As previously discussed, the introduction of synthetic data in these settings provides a benefit even in the absence of SIF. Nevertheless, the adoption of SIF further yields marginal accuracy improvements, with SPC contributing more than SID. This indicates that, when synthetic images are generally of good quality, selecting samples through Synthetic Proxy Classifier that contribute to learning more discriminative class boundaries is crucial for improving classifier performance. Conversely, in scenarios where the introduction of synthetic data leads to performance degradation (SD(txt) on both PhotoMOCI and KOCD, and AC-SG3 on PhotoMOCI), an opposite trend emerges. In such cases, the primary gains are provided by SID, suggesting that low realism and visually implausible synthetic images are the main source of noise responsible for the observed drop in performance, and that their removal mitigates negative effects.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: A preliminary consideration about current photographic oral cancer datasets concerns the practical relevance of binary cancer vs non-cancer (healthy) classifications for photographic screening. Although such datasets support controlled experimentation, especially for benchmarking, they do not reflect real clinical workflows when the negative class consists of healthy mucosa. Physicians would not capture images when no suspicious lesion is visible; rather, photographic assessment is typically relevant after a lesion has already been observed, and the clinical question becomes how to prioritize, characterize, or refer it. Consequently, binary datasets may overstate their utility and fail to represent the operational context in which computer-assisted tools are intended to function. In this sense, the three-class PhotoMOCI formulation, distinguishing aphthous, traumatic, and neoplastic lesions, better approximates a lesion-level triage scenario, where the model must discriminate among visible pathological findings instead of separating pathology from healthy tissue.
blocks.zh: 对目前照相口服癌症数据集的初步考虑涉及二元癌与非癌症(健康)分类在摄影筛查中的实际相关性。 虽然这类数据集支持有控制的实验,特别是用于基准的实验,但当负类由健康的黏膜组成时,它们并不反映真实的临床工作流程. 当没有发现可疑的损伤时,医生不会捕捉到图像;相反,照片评估通常在已观测到损伤后是相关的,临床问题变成如何排列优先顺序、定性或提交。 因此,二进制数据集可能夸大其效用,不能代表计算机辅助工具的运行环境。 从这个意义上讲,三级的光电成份(PhotoMOCI)配体,区分了有刺、有创伤和有肿瘤的损伤,更接近于一种损伤级的分化情况,即模型必须区别明显的病理发现,而不是将病理与健康组织分开。

blocks.en:
Summarizing the experiment results, traditional data augmentation consistently provides solid performance and remains a safe and reliable baseline strategy.
Regarding synthetic data augmentation strategies, the effectiveness of the proposed SIF strongly depends on the quality of the images generated during the earlier Synthetic Image Generation step of the proposed methodology. If the majority of the generated images are of low quality, SIF filters out most samples, resulting in a training setup that closely resembles training without augmentation on small real datasets. This behavior was observed in the ablation study, specifically, in the setup involving SD(txt) on the PhotoMOCI dataset.
blocks.zh:
总结实验结果,传统的数据增强不断提供扎实的性能,仍然是安全可靠的基线战略.
关于合成数据扩增战略,拟议的SIF的有效性在很大程度上取决于拟议方法早先合成图像生成步骤所产生的图像的质量。 如果大多数生成的图像质量低,SIF会过滤出大多数样本,导致培训设置与培训非常相似,而没有在小型真实数据集上增加内容。 这种行为在消化研究中被观察到,具体来说,是在PhotoMOCI数据集中涉及SD(txt)的设置中观察到的.

blocks.en: Although the original datasets are characterized by a relatively balanced class, the analysis reported in Table 6 shows that the SIF preserves this balance after filtering, without favoring any particular pathology. More generally, class imbalance, whether given by the original dataset distributions or introduced during synthetic image generation, is not a limitation of the proposed pipeline. If required, sample discarding strategies during a next step can be adopted to increase the number of retained samples for under-represented categories.

blocks.en: Therefore, the adoption of generative models does not inherently guarantee performance improvements when synthetic samples are incorporated without further selection. The benefit of synthetic data augmentation depends primarily on two factors: (i) the architecture of the generative model and the adopted conditioning mechanism. In some cases, fine-tuning these models can be unstable or may lead to generators that fail to generalize properly, even when trained on limited datasets, as is typical for oral photographic datasets. This phenomenon is evident in the qualitative samples produced by SD(txt) and AC-SG3 in Figure 4 , as well as by SD(txt) in Figure 5 . (ii) The nature of the data, which may be highly granular, as in the case of the PhotoMOCI dataset. Such granularity increases the difficulty of generating realistic samples that faithfully capture the distinctive visual characteristics of the target classes.
blocks.zh: 因此,采用基因模型不能从本质上保证在合成样品不作进一步选择的情况下提高性能。 合成数据增强的好处主要取决于两个因素:(一) 基因模型的结构以及所采用的条件机制。 在某些情况下,这些模型的微调可能是不稳定的,或者可能导致发电机无法正确概括,即使是在有限的数据集上受过训练时也是如此,典型的就是口腔摄影数据集. 这一现象在SD(txt)和AC-SG3在图4中以及SD(txt)在图5中产生的质地样本中显而易见. (二)数据的性质可能具有高度颗粒性,如PhotoMOCI数据集. 这种颗粒性增加了生成真实的样本的困难,这些样本忠实地捕捉了目标类的显著视觉特征.

blocks.en: Based on these considerations, we outline here some practical guidelines for the usage of the proposed methodology illustrated in Figure 2 . Specifically, this methodology should not be considered as a universal plug-and-play pipeline capable of returning an optimal oral lesion classifier. Instead, given the numerous factors affecting DL classifier training (such as the number of classes, class imbalance, single-center data collection, acquisition protocol, limited sample size, or class granularity), it should be considered as a set of guidelines for carefully evaluating each stage of the pipeline before proceeding to the next one. Indeed, these aspects may introduce dataset- and acquisition-specific biases, and should be considered when interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 基于这些考虑,我们在此概述图2所示拟议方法使用的一些实用准则。 具体地说,这种方法不应被视为一个能返回最佳口腔损伤分类器的通用插件和游戏管道。 相反,鉴于影响DL分类培训的众多因素(如班级数目、班级不平衡、单中心数据收集、购置协议、样本有限、或班级颗粒性),应当将其视为一套准则,以便在进入下一阶段之前仔细评估管道的每一阶段。 事实上,这些方面可能带来数据集和购置方面的偏差,在解释结果时应予以考虑。

The proposed training pipeline presents some drawbacks compared to DL training based on traditional data augmentation techniques involving geometric and photometric transformations. These drawbacks mainly relate to increased computational requirements and additional human effort.
While traditional data augmentation relies on training a single classifier, where augmentations are typically applied at runtime and are well supported by modern DL libraries, the proposed methodology presents the following practical considerations:

As shown in Table 5 , SD(txt) clearly exhibits difficulties in generating high-quality synthetic images. Generating synthetic samples and evaluating them with SIF on-the-fly during training would be particularly challenging, especially for diffusion-based models, whose inference process involves multiple diffusion steps.

(2024) , training a generative model remains challenging, particularly in limited-data scenarios. Under the assumption that sufficient computational resources are available and that multiple training trials, or preferably a systematic hyperparameter optimization procedure, can be conducted, the proposed methodology represents the most effective strategy among those evaluated in our benchmark for improving classification performance under the considered experimental setting, as indicated in Tables 7 and 8 .

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This work addresses the challenges of data scarcity and investigates the synthetic data augmentation in photographic oral cancer. We introduced PhotoMOCI, a novel dataset designed to support multiple diagnostic tasks in the oral cancer domain, providing a publicly available resource for open research and benchmarking.
We also conduct a comprehensive evaluation of data augmentation strategies, comparing traditional transformation-based methods with generative approaches based on GANs and Diffusion Models.
Our findings indicate that the direct use of synthetic images does not consistently improve classification performance and may even be counterproductive, emphasizing that synthetic data quality is critical in this setting.
To address this limitation, we proposed the Synthetic Image Filter , which selects synthetic samples based on machine-assessed visual realism and class representativeness using two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier and Synthetic Image Detector. Although qualitative inspection shows visual analogies between some retained synthetic images and real oral lesions, the term realism in this work refers specifically to machine indistinguishability from the real-image distribution, rather than to clinical realism or diagnostic plausibility. Experimental results show that this selective strategy effectively removes low-utility images and leads to more stable and improved downstream performance.
blocks.zh:
这项工作解决了数据稀缺的挑战,并调查了口腔癌照片中合成数据的增强。 我们引入了PhotoMOCI,这是一个新的数据集,旨在支持口腔癌领域的多种诊断任务,为公开研究和基准设定提供了公开资源.
我们还对数据扩充战略进行了全面评估,将传统变换方法与基于GANs和扩散模型的基因方法进行比较。
我们的研究结果表明,直接使用合成图像并不能持续改善分类性能,甚至可能适得其反,强调合成数据质量在这一背景下至关重要.
为了解决这一局限性,我们提出了合成图像过滤器(Synthetic Image Filter),它利用两个辅助模型:合成代号分类器和合成图像探测器,根据机器评估的视觉现实主义和类代表性选择合成样品. 虽然质检显示出一些保留合成图像与真实口腔损伤之间的视觉类比,但本作中的现实主义一词特指机器与真实影像分布的无法区分,而不是临床现实主义或诊断性合理性. 实验结果显示,这种选择性策略有效地消除了低功用图像,导致下游性能更加稳定和改善.

blocks.en:
Overall, this study highlights the importance of careful dataset design and controlled use of generative augmentation in photographic oral cancer imaging, offering a comprehensive benchmark for future research on reliable data augmentation pipelines.
At the same time, the reported improvements should be regarded as dataset-specific experimental findings. The single-center origin of PhotoMOCI and the absence of an human expert assessment of the SIF-selected images represent a limitation; external and clinical validation would be strongly recommended before assessing its applicability in real-world screening workflows.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,本研究强调了仔细的数据集设计和在照相口腔癌成像中控制使用基因增强的重要性,为今后关于可靠数据增强管道的研究提供了一个全面的基准.
与此同时,所报告的改进应被视为针对数据集的试验结果。 PhotoMOCI的单中心来源和缺乏对SIF所选图像的人类专家评估是一个局限性;在评估其在现实世界筛选工作流程中的适用性之前,将强烈建议外部和临床验证。

blocks.en: 7.1 Future work
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 今后的工作

blocks.en:
The proposed pipeline enables a multi-level evaluation of synthetic images and their impact when used as data augmentation for downstream tasks such as image classification.
Specifically, (i) assessing generative image metrics at the Synthetic Image Generation stage, (ii) employing auxiliary classifiers assess image realism and class representativeness in the Synthetic Image Filter, while (iii) the final evaluation considers the effect of selected synthetic data on downstream performance.
Given the importance of trustworthiness when deploying AI in high-risk domains such as healthcare, model transparency and alignment with human judgment are crucial Longo et al. (2024) ; Parola et al. (2026) ; Rong et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
拟议的管道能够对合成图像及其影响进行多层次的评价,如果用作图像分类等下游任务的数据补充。
